skill_outcomes.skill_name: Describe the operation of software on a computer
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand how Java works and apply basic programming techniques.
Use control structures, functions, object-oriented programming, input/output, multithreading, and general programming concepts.
Evaluate software quality and performance, and develop user interfaces.
Complete assignments and solve problems related to Java programming.
Work together to complete group projects on time.
Complete assignments and participate in discussions.
Defend personal opinions before a group.
Collaborate with team members to complete assigned tasks.
